title: Niagara/flipbook material-wiring execution spec (Fix A + twin SHIP + defaults sweep)

execution_contract.surface: One BS_GodFile editor session via Monolith (:9316). Never the HumberToonShader editor (foreign project, was the only listener on 2026-10-16).
execution_contract.tool: Tools/apply_vfx_flipbook_wiring.py (--audit read-only default; --apply only rows revalidated live)
execution_contract.save_rule: Owner Ctrl+S of dirty packages only
execution_contract.idempotency: Every row is re-read live before applying; already-satisfied rows are skipped and logged.
guards: Refuse to run unless monolith selftest passes AND the connected project is BS_GodFile (MelodiaMelusinaV2).
Never pass overwrite=true to batch_retarget_animations anywhere (editor-fatal). This spec does not touch retargets.
Never edit M_Niagara_MelodiaFlipbook (master) or any master; MI-only rows are permitted, masters are excluded from target paths.
Never delete; twin archive happens in a dedicated owner Content PR.

A_renderer_binding_repair.purpose: Close the 5 renderer-material bindings that failed with ok:false / materials_bound:0 in the 2026-10-11 pass. All target materials verified to exist on disk offline.
A_renderer_binding_repair.monolith_pattern: niagara_query set_renderer_material {asset_path, emitter, renderer_index, material}; read-back via get_emitter_summary renderers; record receipt.

B_fix_a_flipbook_policy.purpose: Extend the owner-proven Fix A rule (material owns scrub; SubUVAnimation disabled; SubImageSize 1x1; never double-scrub) to every Niagara system consuming a flipbook that is not yet confirmed compliant. Row list is populated by the live audit pass; offline candidates are documented in Saved/Audit/OfflineNiagaraPrep_20261016/audit_prep.json.
B_fix_a_flipbook_policy.monolith_pattern: niagara_query: set_module_enabled {asset_path, emitter, module, enabled:false} for the SubUVAnimation update module; set_emitter_property/set_module_input_value SubImageSize -> [1,1]; set_static_switch_value only where Sprite Size Mode fixes are needed (does not belong to this family).

row_rule.only_if: system consumes a flipbook-based MI AND live read-back shows SubUVAnimation enabled OR SubImageSize != (1,1)
row_rule.always_log: before/after values, node ids where returned

C_editor_defaults_sweep.purpose: Ensure no Niagara system renderer references an editor-default material. Detection only in this pass; remaps ONLY when an explicit mapping row exists, never implicit guesses.
C_editor_defaults_sweep.remap_rule: Only rows present in remap_rows may be rewritten; any other default hit is log-only for owner triage (fix_niagara_render_faults.py precedent: explicit mapping per emitter only).

D_twin_ship_reparent_ownership.purpose: Retarget remaining consumers off /Game/_PROJECT/ (DUPLICATE twin) onto /Game/Melodia/_PROJECT/ (SHIP). These rows are owner-class actions (twin audit steps 1-5); the agent tool only AUDITS and lists consumers, never reparents in this family.

open_twin_breaks.evidence: TWIN audit 2026-09-17 fold-in + offline file-size hint (both copies are real MIs, 8.4KB vs 11.0KB)
VFX_FIXA receipt 2026-10-10 states the parent path explicitly as the twin

open_twin_breaks.consumer: all MI_Niagara_Melodia_Static_* family members and any NS renderer binding them (beat-map systems NS_Melusina_ImpactBurst/Ripple/Sigil/StarPop/Splash are prime candidates)
open_twin_breaks.intended: Melodia SHIP equivalents once redirected/created; live Asset Registry enumeration required
open_twin_breaks.evidence: TWIN audit 'Related Content Static_* MIs should eventually reparent to Melodia Flipbook SHIP (owner batch)'

do_not: recreate the twin family at SHIP without owner decision on redirect placement
archive Content/_PROJECT in any lane other than the dedicated owner Content PR

E_glitter_pile_bake_queue.purpose: Offline-baked 6x5/12fps glitter-pile flipbook atlases (pile + ring variants, 5 maps each, full + Compact) waiting for owner import into Content/. Complements (never replaces) the shader-side MF_MelodiaGlitterPile work.
E_glitter_pile_bake_queue.proposed_ship_paths: PENDING OWNER NAME CONFIRMATION (e.g. /Game/Melodia/VFX/Flipbooks/T_GlitterPile_pile_Atlas_6x5_BaseColor). No Content/ import may run without it.

import_contract.compression: per playbook §2.3 grayscale/packed rule per map
import_contract.fix_a_policy: materials own scrub — SubUVAnimation off, SubImageSize [1,1]

wiring_rows_after_import.candidates_offline: NS_Morning_GlitterGlint (family A row), NS_Melodia_LeafPileLoop family, beat-map pile-like systems — live enumeration required; no implicit remap.

E_glitter_pile_bake_queue.state: baked-with-evidence; import blocked on owner path/name decision
E_glitter_pile_bake_queue.evidence: determinism 0/10 sha diffs per variant across two runs; ring modality proven by per-cell radial band check (annulus-bounded vs pile field coverage)

must_record: dirty package list for owner Ctrl+S
editor project name + PID asserted by guard

gates_definition_for_ledger.pass_condition: audit receipt exists with zero editor-default hits in /Game/Melodia/** NS systems AND family A rows re-read as bound to intended materials AND Fix A policy rows read SubUVAnimation=disabled, SubImageSize=(1,1)
gates_definition_for_ledger.run_via: python Tools/echo_run.py spec (ledger row via record_gate.py only after live pass)
